description: TAIL SECTION ONLY. The complete airframe stood at the Arc Light Memorial commemorating the B-52 conventional bombing missions flown from Andersen AFB during the Vietnam War; it deteriorated in Guam's climate and was scrapped from about 2014; the vertical tail was preserved and mounted on a plinth alongside a tail from a B-52H and the memorial was redesigned around a B-52D silhouette laid out on the ground; further sections went to Andersen's Heritage Hall in the passenger terminal. An earlier B-52D 55-0100 at the same site was scrapped in 1983. Every published list still shows the whole aircraft here; it is not there. Source Vintage Aviation News
museum_name: Arc Light Memorial -- Andersen Air Force Base
